description:
Permanently delete a file or a folder (including everything inside it) from your Nekoweb site. This cannot be undone.

Example: "Remove the old drafts folder" -> { path: "/mysite.nekoweb.org/drafts" }

path.description: Path from the account's file root, including the site folder, e.g. '/mysite.nekoweb.org/old-page.html'

name: nekoweb_delete
title: Delete file or folder
